import ast

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BUILD = REPO / 'build'
SKILLS = REPO / 'skills'
sys.path.insert(0, str(BUILD))

import check_frontmatter as cf  # noqa: E402
import check_provenance as cp  # noqa: E402

SUPERPOWERS_SOURCE = 'https://github.com/obra/superpowers'
THREE_HOST_KEY_SKILLS = {'bayesian-workflow', 'tune-hyperparameters', 'tech-debt'}
NO_UV_SENTENCE = (
    'Without uv, run the same path with `python3` in an environment '
    "that has the dependencies listed in the script's header."
)


def skill_dirs():
    return sorted(p for p in SKILLS.iterdir() if (p / 'SKILL.md').is_file())


def load_fm(skill_dir):
    text = (skill_dir / 'SKILL.md').read_text()
    _, fm_text, _ = text.split('---\n', 2)
    return yaml.safe_load(fm_text)


def write_skill(root, name, fm_text, body='Body.\n'):
    d = root / 'skills' / name
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (d / 'SKILL.md').write_text(f'---\n{fm_text}---\n{body}')
    return d


def base_fm(name='demo', extra=''):
    return f"name: {name}\ndescription: 'Use when testing.'\nlicense: MIT\n{extra}"


def write_script(skill_dir, filename, text):
    s = skill_dir / 'scripts'
    s.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = s / filename
    p.write_text(text)
    return p


HEADER_STDLIB = (
    "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
    "# /// script\n"
    "# requires-python = '>=3.11'\n"
    "# dependencies = []\n"
    "# ///\n"
)
MAIN = "\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    pass\n"


def header_with(deps):
    quoted = ', '.join(f"'{d}'" for d in deps)
    return (
        "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n"
        "# /// script\n"
        "# requires-python = '>=3.11'\n"
        f"# dependencies = [{quoted}]\n"
        "# ///\n"
    )


def superpowers_skills():
    out = set()
    for d in skill_dirs():
        md = load_fm(d).get('metadata') or {}
        if md.get('source') == SUPERPOWERS_SOURCE:
            out.add(d.name)
    return out

# spec: "Here 3.X is the highest `requires-python` floor among the scripts that skill invokes."
# task: 12
def test_repo_compatibility_values():
    seen = set()
    for d in skill_dirs():
        uv_paths = [(md, p) for md, r, p in cf.bundled_invocations(d) if r == 'uv run']
        if not uv_paths:
            continue
        seen.add(d.name)
        floors = []
        for _, p in uv_paths:
            script = cf.resolve_bundled_script(p, d)
            assert script is not None, (d.name, p)
            rp = cf.script_metadata(script.read_text())['requires-python']
            floors.append(tuple(int(x) for x in rp.removeprefix('>=').split('.')))
        hi = max(floors)
        expected = ('Requires uv to run bundled scripts (dependencies are declared inline); '
                    f'Python {hi[0]}.{hi[1]}+.')
        assert load_fm(d).get('compatibility') == expected, d.name
    assert 'finishing-a-development-branch' in seen

def make_repo(tmp_path):
    repo = tmp_path / 'repo'
    (repo / 'skills' / 'a').mkdir(parents=True)
    (repo / 'skills' / 'b').mkdir(parents=True)
    (repo / 'LICENSE').write_text('MIT plain\n')
    (repo / 'LICENSE-x').write_text('MIT x\n')
    for s in ('a', 'b'):
        (repo / 'skills' / s / 'LICENSE').write_text('MIT plain\n')
    (repo / 'skills' / 'a' / 'LICENSE-x').write_text('MIT x\n')
    return repo, ['a', 'b'], {'LICENSE-x': ('a',)}

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mutation', ['missing_plain', 'missing_mapped', 'symlink', 'differs'])
def test_provenance_copy_violations(tmp_path, mutation):
    repo, skills, table = make_repo(tmp_path)
    if mutation == 'missing_plain':
        (repo / 'skills' / 'b' / 'LICENSE').unlink()
    elif mutation == 'missing_mapped':
        (repo / 'skills' / 'a' / 'LICENSE-x').unlink()
    elif mutation == 'symlink':
        p = repo / 'skills' / 'a' / 'LICENSE-x'
        p.unlink()
        p.symlink_to(repo / 'LICENSE-x')
    elif mutation == 'differs':
        (repo / 'skills' / 'a' / 'LICENSE').write_text('MIT plain \n')
    assert cp.bundled_license_violations(repo, skills, table) != []

# spec: "- The script stays stdlib-only, so its CLAUDE.md command keeps no `--with`."
# task: 8
def test_check_provenance_stdlib_only():
    tree = ast.parse((BUILD / 'check_provenance.py').read_text())
    local = {p.stem for p in BUILD.glob('*.py')}
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            mods = [a.name.split('.')[0] for a in node.names]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.level == 0:
            mods = [node.module.split('.')[0]]
        else:
            continue
        for m in mods:
            assert m in sys.stdlib_module_names or m in local, m
    for line in (REPO / 'CLAUDE.md').read_text().splitlines():
        if 'check_provenance.py' in line:
            assert '--with' not in line
